status: Analyst priors; not measured coefficients or expert-elicited consensus

parameters.name: research_spillover
parameters.definition: Marginal long-run response of Chinese capability to a U.S. research-quality shock, separate from teacher access.
parameters.rationale: No direct causal estimate. This analyst prior allows negligible reliance through substantial dependence, with independent Chinese research dominant.

parameters.name: teacher_spillover
parameters.definition: Marginal response to the quality of accessible U.S. models as teachers/research tools.
parameters.rationale: Analyst prior; first-party distillation activity and teacher-student ablations show a channel but do not measure national foreign dependence.

parameters.name: knowledge_lag_days
parameters.definition: Lag before new U.S. knowledge or teacher quality affects Chinese development.
parameters.rationale: Analyst prior separating access from assimilation and incorporation into a new model.

parameters.name: absorption_days
parameters.definition: Time constant for the diffusion response after the lag.
parameters.rationale: Analyst prior allowing gradual adjustment and substitute discovery.

parameters.name: reverse_spillover
parameters.definition: Marginal U.S. capability response to Chinese knowledge shocks.
parameters.rationale: Analyst prior; reverse diffusion is possible but smaller in this frontier-led baseline.

sensitivity_contract: Report zero, half, and double forward reliance, and zero reverse reliance. Replace teacher prior with the access module derived parameter if supported by its calibration.
